tests.title: writes the focused object id to the store when Tab is pressed
tests.scenario: Given a BootScene with one focused fake object 'bookshelf', When Tab is pressed on the keydown handler, Then useGameStore.focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf'

tests.id: tests/bootSceneKeyboardStore.test.ts::BootScene keyboard store focus calls setFocusedObject with the focused object id when Shift+Tab is pressed
tests.name: BootScene keyboard store focus > calls setFocusedObject with the focused object id when Shift+Tab is pressed
tests.title: calls setFocusedObject with the focused object id when Shift+Tab is pressed

tests.scenario: Given a BootScene with one focused fake object 'bookshelf', When ArrowLeft is pressed, Then setFocusedObject is called with 'bookshelf' and focusChange is emitted with { id: 'bookshelf' }

units.title: Verify: Store focus is null when nothing focused and apply is a no-op

tests.name: BootScene keyboard store null and apply > stores a null focusedObjectId and emits focusChange with null when Tab is pressed and nothing is focused
tests.title: stores a null focusedObjectId and emits focusChange with null when Tab is pressed and nothing is focused
tests.scenario: Given the scene has one unfocused object, when Tab is pressed, then the store focusedObjectId is null and focusChange is emitted with { id: null }

tests.name: BootScene keyboard store null and apply > does not blur the focused object when the store focus is re-applied to that same object on Tab
tests.title: does not blur the focused object when the store focus is re-applied to that same object on Tab
tests.scenario: Given the scene object is focused, when Tab is pressed and the store is updated with that same object's id, then blur is not called on it
